title: polypodium aureum var. leucatomos
intro: Polypodium aureum var. leucatomos, commonly known as Leucotomos Fern, is a variety of the Goldthread Fern (Polypodium aureum) plant, native to Central and South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including protection against sun damage, anti-inflammatory effects, and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Leucotomos Fern include its ability to modulate the immune system and its potential as an anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular ingredient in skincare products and supplements. Bioactive constituents of Leucotomos Fern include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
